concepts.gloss_en: a stillbirth/miscarried fetus — metaphor for false-famous leaders (מפרסמים) who emerge before their proper time

reason_for_human: נפל (נֶפֶל, singular) and נפלים (נְפָלִים, plural) are the same word — a simple singular/plural inflection, not homographs. Both occur in the same teaching (lm2:20) with identical meaning: stillbirths as the metaphor for those who become famous before their time. Straightforward merge.
